Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its reasoning regarding the size of the largest stars. It incorrectly stated that the largest main-sequence stars have radii of "roughly 10 solar radii." In reality, the largest main-sequence stars (O-type stars) can be significantly larger (up to ~10-20 solar radii), but the largest stars overall (red supergiants like Betelgeuse or UY Scuti) have radii ranging from hundreds to over 1,000 solar radii. Because the Planner failed to account for these hyper-giant stars which are hundreds of times larger than the Sun, it incorrectly concluded that the Sun would not be "tiny" next to the largest stars, leading it to choose option A instead of the correct option B.
